label: The knee frequency
subgoals: Take the 10 to 90 percent rise time of the edge
Divide 0.35 by it to get the knee frequency

label: Inductive versus resistive impedance
subgoals: Compute the angular frequency at the knee
Multiply by the loop inductance of the wire
Divide by the wire resistance and compare with one

label: Time of flight and damping
subgoals: Multiply the length by the square root of L'C'
Compare the rise time with twice the time of flight
Compare total resistance with twice the characteristic impedance
